deviations_from_reference: Synthetic 9-frame sequence rather than upstream's longer driving sequences.
sin-space → uniform-angle azimuth resample (matches RadarSplat baseline).
Pose rotation +90° CCW about world-Z to align cascade wedge with sampler row 0.
azim_span_deg=180 via 1-line patch to radarfields/sampler.py (patches/azim_span.patch); upstream default 360 unchanged.
Combined tx*rx MMWCAS antenna LUT for azimuth; flat 0 dBic elevation LUT (no measured elevation pattern for cascade).
--refine_poses disabled (small-n training set; remove a confound).
